doc_friction.issue: The 400 MB audio cap is justified by GitHub Pages' 1 GB site limit, but the site is now served by Cloudflare Workers (portfolio/hosting/README.md), whose limits are per-file size and 20,000 files per Worker, not 1 GB. The cap may still be right for git history growth, but its stated reason is stale; this run followed it anyway (text only).

The Next up Bakhita proposal was accurate; one widely used online biography (Wikipedia) has the future Pius X baptizing her in January 1890, before he was Patriarch of Venice. The story follows Spe Salvi and names only 'the Patriarch of Venice'.
